method.runtime: Actual Electron main, preload and built renderer at 1280x720 and 100% zoom. Disposable appData and synthetic localhost Jellyfin; no user account/data mutation.
method.adapters: Shared key reader returns null; fixture seed creates local DJs, profiles and one bundled MP3 take; save hold/failure injected immediately before actual IPC operation. Missing-portrait case returns 404 from actual wave-app handler. External fetches blocked and counted.
method.storage: Actual encrypted connection and filesystem local-state/prepared-news paths, reopened in fresh Electron processes.
method.intermediate: Earlier run used a renderer built before the swatch fix; another fixture wait inspected input.disabled instead of inherited :disabled. Final 12-case run uses corrected renderer and selector.

limits: No new unit tests or framework. No live provider calls, audible quality, VoiceOver or deferred smaller-window/zoom acceptance claimed.
Actual pending automatic provider run and in-flight room-save race were source-reviewed, not reproduced in this fixture.
Generated portraits are bundled PNGs; no user uploads or live avatar generation.
